passCriteria: Untouched square image retains the original 1:1 ratio in source and overlay.
Landscape and portrait images retain original proportions within one CSS pixel at normal and narrow widths.
Repeated selections and table-cell images retain proportions without page overflow.
Copied unsafe dimensions/styles cannot stretch images; canonical speech mapping and existing image safety still pass.

tests.title: Untouched original square image in selected article
tests.userStory: Read a selected article while seeing its included image in the pop-up.
tests.setup: Confirmed loopback fixture server, actual Chromium article Copy, original 1024 by 1024 logo bytes and production overlay/preload.
steps: Copy selection and read HTML clipboard content
Send captured HTML to the overlay
Wait for image decode and inspect visible order
expectedResults: Selected image decodes in the overlay
Canonical speech excludes image alt text
Clipboard HTML resolves relative image URL
Source natural and displayed proportions match the original square asset
Overlay height equals width times original aspect ratio within one CSS pixel
proof: Clipboard HTML and renderer result assertions

tests.title: Square, landscape, portrait and table-cell images after resize and repeat reading
tests.userStory: Keep images readable at small sizes and avoid old images leaking into another reading.
tests.setup: Same production overlay at 740 and 430 pixels; independent true landscape/portrait bitmap fixtures and width-only thumbnail.
steps: Check image bounds and aspect ratio
Check old images are removed and new images decode
expectedResults: Second reading contains only new images
Every rendered image matches original fixture ratio within one CSS pixel
Portrait and table-cell images preserve proportions

tests.title: Hostile copied dimensions cannot stretch images; reading regressions
tests.userStory: Read copied material safely without disrupting existing reading layouts.
tests.setup: Hostile clipboard HTML with event handlers, file/script/blob/SVG data URLs, a missing HTTP image, and a table. Production CSP remains active.
steps: Inspect rebuilt attributes and attempted requests
Load plain-text reading and inspect words
expectedResults: Only allowed image URLs are rendered
Missing image does not interrupt text
Plain text reading has no stale images
Copied width 9000, height 1 and styling do not change original image proportions
